sources.name: OGC API - Features - Part 1: Core
verified_facts: The Core defines discovery and query operations for feature resources.
Core feature geometries use WGS 84 with longitude/latitude axis order.
The default CRS identifiers are CRS84 without height and CRS84h with ellipsoidal height.
semantic_limits: Core WGS 84 transport coordinates must not replace native EPSG:27700 geometry for exact parcel containment.
An optional third coordinate in the Core is ellipsoidal height and must not be treated as ODN terrain height.

sources.name: OGC API - Features - Part 2: Coordinate Reference Systems by Reference
verified_facts: A collection advertises supported CRS identifiers and may declare its storage CRS.
The crs parameter requests response geometry coordinates in a supported CRS.
The bbox-crs parameter identifies the CRS of bounding-box coordinates; unsupported CRS values require HTTP 400.
semantic_limits: Server-side coordinate transformation does not prove parcel geometry validity or elevation accuracy.
The requested and returned CRS must be read back explicitly; a successful HTTP response is insufficient.

sources.publisher: Internet Engineering Task Force / RFC Editor
sources.name: RFC 7946 — The GeoJSON Format
verified_facts: GeoJSON coordinates use WGS 84 longitude and latitude in decimal degrees.
GeoJSON position order is longitude, latitude, with an optional third altitude element.
GeoJSON does not define a representation for positional uncertainty.
semantic_limits: GeoJSON display coordinates cannot carry the native EPSG:27700 measurement contract by themselves.
The optional altitude element is not evidence of ODN height, LiDAR provenance or parcel-level uncertainty.

sources.name: OGC GeoPackage Encoding Standard 1.3.1
verified_facts: A Polygon is restricted to rings defined as simple, closed LineStrings.
Feature geometry columns reference an SRS identifier and geometries must use the column SRS.
GeoPackage WKB coordinate order is x,y with optional z and m, where x is easting or longitude and y is northing or latitude.
semantic_limits: A valid container and closed rings do not establish legal-boundary accuracy or correct HMLR identity.
The meaning and unit of an optional z value depend on the CRS and must not be inferred from the presence of a third ordinate.
